log.text: Light Screen up on P1's side
Gholdengo used Make It Rain → Whimsicott
Light Screen ended on P1's side

decisions.rationale: No Mega — sun neuters Swampert-Mega (Waterfall halved, no Swift Swim). Lead Incineroar+Klefki: Fake Out flinches Charizard turn 1 while Prankster Light Screen lets both survive Heat Wave (Incineroar resists, Klefki at ~32%). Turn 2 Klefki TWave paralyzes Charizard; Incineroar Parting Shot pivots to Gholdengo who outspeeds paralyzed Zard and KOs with Thunderbolt (41-110%). Farigiraf back for Armor Tail blocking Prankster Encore/Fake Out and TR option vs Tailwind.
decisions.notebook:
Opponent roster: Charizard-Mega-Y (Timid, Heat Wave/SolarBeam/Weather Ball), Whimsicott (Timid, FocusSash, Prankster Tailwind+Encore), Archaludon (Modest, Leftovers, Stamina — gains Def on every hit, hit it with special moves), Grimmsnarl (Impish, LightClay, Prankster screens+Fake Out), Stunfisk-Galar (Adamant, Sitrus, Mimicry, EQ), Quaquaval (Jolly, LifeOrb, Moxie, Aqua Step). Opponent tendency: Tailwind + dual screens hyper-offense shell, Encore from Whimsicott. Archaludon is primary special wall/wincon snowballing with Stamina — only special hits bypass Def boosts.

Key damage facts: Charizard-Mega-Y sun Heat Wave OHKOs Gholdengo (SE vs Steel, STAB+sun). Incineroar resists Heat Wave (Fire typing, ~28%). Klefki survives Heat Wave with Light Screen (~68% dmg, ~32% HP left). Gholdengo Thunderbolt = 41-110% on Charizard-Mega-Y (unreliable KO). Charizard-Mega-Y outspeeds Gholdengo (115-167 vs 104). Swampert-Mega underperforms in sun: Waterfall halved, no Swift Swim, outsped under Tailwind — do not bring vs Charizard-Y.

Game 2 plan: Lead Incineroar+Klefki (no Mega). T1 Fake Out flinches Charizard + Prankster Light Screen. T2 Klefki TWave Charizard + Incineroar Parting Shot to Gholdengo. T3 Gholdengo outspeeds paralyzed Zard, Thunderbolt KOs. Farigiraf back for Armor Tail (blocks Prankster Encore/Fake Out) and TR vs Tailwind. Preserve Gholdengo until Charizard is paralyzed or KO'd.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Charizard-Y. Lead Whimsicott + Grimmsnarl: Whimsicott uses Prankster Encore to lock Pelipper into Rain Dance/Tailwind, Grimmsnarl FakeOuts or sets Reflect/Light Screen. Back: Quaquaval sweeps with Ice Spinner vs Swampert and Close Combat vs Gholdengo/Incineroar, snowballing with Moxie. Charizard-Y provides Heat Wave pressure on Gholdengo/Incineroar, especially if Pelipper falls.
decisions.notebook: Opponent relies on Pelipper + Swampert rain core (Damp Rock 8-turn rain, Swift Swim Mega Swampert). Gholdengo is Modest with Leftovers, Good as Gold blocks status, Make It Rain + Shadow Ball. Incineroar is Careful with Sitrus Berry, Intimidate + FakeOut + Parting Shot. Farigiraf has Mental Herb (cures Encore), Trick Room + Helping Hand. Klefki has Prankster + Light Clay for screens/TWave. Charizard-Y loses weather war vs Pelipper but can still pressure Gholdengo/Incineroar with Heat Wave if Pelipper is eliminated. Archaludon's Electric/Steel attacks fail vs Gholdengo (Good as Gold blocks status, Steel/Ghost resists both). Quaquaval's Ice Spinner 2x vs Swampert, Close Combat neutral vs Gholdengo/Incineroar. Whimsicott's Prankster Encore (+1 priority) outspeeds Pelipper's Rain Dance (priority 0). Mental Herb on Farigiraf cures Encore immediately, so don't Encore it. Prioritize eliminating Gholdengo with Heat Wave or Close Combat. Avoid leading Charizard-Y into rain core.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Incineroar)
decisions.rationale: Fake Out (+3) is guaranteed before Whimsicott's Prankster Tailwind (+1), flinching it and breaking Focus Sash — denying their primary speed control. Klefki Light Screen (Prankster +1) sets up for Charizard-Mega-Y's special nukes. Worst case: Grimmsnarl outspeeds and Fake Outs Incineroar, but Klefki still gets Light Screen. Best case: Grimmsnarl screens or targets Klefki, and I deny Tailwind entirely.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 plan intact: Lead Incineroar+Klefki. T1 Fake Out Whimsicott (deny Tailwind, break Sash) + Light Screen for Charizard-Y. T2: Klefki TWave Charizard on switch-in + Incineroar Parting Shot to Gholdengo. T3: Gholdengo outspeeds paralyzed Zard, Thunderbolt KO. Farigiraf back for Armor Tail (blocks Prankster Encore/Fake Out) and TR vs Tailwind. Preserve Gholdengo until Charizard paralyzed or KO'd. Grimmsnarl Fake Out speed vs Incineroar uncertain (65-112 vs 80) — if Grimmsnarl flinches Incineroar T1, Tailwind gets up but Light Screen still covers. Opponent dual-screen Tailwind HO shell; Archaludon special-only wincon.

decisions.rationale: Tailwind is essential to outspeed rain-core threats later. Prankster Fake Out flinches Incineroar before it can Parting Shot into Pelipper or Will-O-Wisp. Klefki's Dazzling Gleam (2x) is the main risk, but Grimmsnarl survives at full HP and Tailwind + free turn from flinch outweighs it. Encore fails turn 1 since Klefki hasn't moved yet.

decisions.rationale: Switching Incineroar to Gholdengo happens before moves, so Prankster Encore targets incoming Gholdengo (no last move→fails). Gholdengo's base 60 Atk Modest makes Foul Play negligible (~35-45%, tool doesn't model Foul Play's target-Atk mechanic). Klefki TWave paralyzes Whimsicott for speed control; if opp switches to Zard-Y, TWave hits it on switch-in. Even if Klefki gets Encored into Light Screen, switch to Farigiraf next turn for Armor Tail. Best tempo play that dodges the Encore trap and advan
decisions.notebook: Game 2 plan: Lead Inci+Klefki done. T2: switch Inci→Gholdengo (dodge Encore on Fake Out), Klefki TWave Whimsicott. T3+: Gholdengo Thunderbolt/MakeItRain vs paralyzed targets. Farigiraf reserved for Armor Tail (blocks Prankster Encore/Tailwind/screens) — bring in if Klefki gets Encored or when opp Tailwind is up. Opponent dual-Prankster screen+Tailwind HO shell; Charizard-Y is primary threat (Mega Drought, Heat Wave/SolarBeam/WeatherBall). Archaludon special wincon. Note: estimate_damage tool does NOT model Foul Play (uses attacker Atk instead of target Atk); Gholdengo base 60 Atk Modest = Foul Play ~35-45%, not OHKO. Opp Encore on Fake Out users is key threat — always switch or Protect before Encore lands.

decisions.rationale: Tailwind provides crucial speed control for our backline (Quaquaval, Charizard-Y), while Reflect mitigates physical damage from the anticipated rain core switch-in. Encore is risky if they switch, and Tailwind's immediate impact is too valuable to delay.
decisions.notebook: Opponent relies on Pelipper + Swampert rain core. Gholdengo is Modest with Leftovers, Good as Gold. Incineroar is Careful with Sitrus Berry. Farigiraf has Mental Herb. Klefki has Prankster + Light Clay. Charizard-Y loses weather war vs Pelipper but pressures Gholdengo/Incineroar. Quaquaval's Ice Spinner 2x vs Swampert. Prioritize eliminating Gholdengo. Avoid leading Charizard-Y into rain core.

decisions.rationale: Make It Rain guarantees KO on Whimsicott (89.8% min from 83%) and heavily damages Grimmsnarl (74-217%). Switching Klefki to Farigiraf dodges Encore (Klefki's last move was TWave = useless lock) and brings Armor Tail, blocking all opposing Prankster priority (Encore, Protect, Tailwind) going forward. Grimmsnarl Foul Play goes first (Tailwind 130-224 > 104) but does minimal dmg using Gholdengo's 72 Atk at -1. Moonblast is neutral vs Farigiraf, not threatening. Best tempo + permanent priority block
decisions.notebook: Game 2 plan update: T3 play = Gholdengo Make It Rain (guaranteed KO on Whimsicott 83%) + Klefki→Farigiraf switch (Armor Tail blocks Prankster Encore/Protect/Tailwind). Next: Gholdengo+Farigiraf vs Grimmsnarl(LOW)+incoming. Farigiraf Helping Hand boosts Gholdengo; Trick Room available to reverse Tailwind speed tiers. Opponent Tailwind expires T5. Key: Armor Tail is permanent Prankster counter — keep Farigiraf alive. Charizard-Y (Mega Drought) still primary threat; Archaludon special wincon. Incineroar at 94% on bench for Intimidate/Parting Shot pivot. Klefki on bench with Light Clay screens + TWave if needed later. Moonblast is NEUTRAL vs Farigiraf (Fairy vs Normal/Psychic = 1x), not SE.

decisions.rationale: Encore locks Klefki into Thunder Wave, which is useless against Grimmsnarl (Dark immune) and Gholdengo (Good as Gold). Grimmsnarl outspeeds both foes with Tailwind, so Foul Play hits Gholdengo first, pressuring the biggest threat. This neutralizes Klefki completely while focusing damage on Gholdengo.
decisions.notebook: Opponent relies on Pelipper + Swampert rain core. Gholdengo is Modest with Leftovers, Good as Gold. Incineroar is Careful with Sitrus Berry. Farigiraf has Mental Herb. Klefki has Prankster + Light Clay. Charizard-Y loses weather war vs Pelipper but pressures Gholdengo/Incineroar. Quaquaval's Ice Spinner 2x vs Swampert. Prioritize eliminating Gholdengo. Avoid leading Charizard-Y into rain core. Encore is highly effective vs Prankster support that relies on status moves.

decisions.rationale: Sending Charizard left and Quaquaval right aligns Charizard's HeatWave against Gholdengo and Quaquaval's Close Combat against Farigiraf. Mega Charizard-Y seizes the weather war against Pelipper and pressures the Steel/Ghost core, while Quaquaval cleans up Farigiraf and threatens Swampert with Ice Spinner.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Gholdengo)
decisions.rationale: Switching Gholdengo to Incineroar brings Intimidate (-1 Quaquaval Atk), cutting Close Combat damage from 41-133% to ~27-89%, giving Farigiraf a strong chance to survive Heat Wave+CC and set TR. Incineroar resists Heat Wave (0.5x). Gholdengo's SpA-2 resets on switch, returning at full power under TR. Next turn under TR I outspeed both foes and can pivot Incineroar->Gholdengo for clean Thunderbolt/MIR damage.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: CharizarditeY Mega Evolves T4 -> Drought active. Tool does NOT apply sun weather boost (reports weather 1x) nor Weather Ball type/BP change in weather — must manually account for 1.5x Fire boost and Weather Ball becoming Fire/100BP in sun. My Light Screen (doubles 2/3 reduction) roughly cancels sun boost on special Fire moves. Opponent Tailwind expires end of T5. Trick Room reverses speed: my 72/80/104 outspeed foe 198-334 under TR even with Tailwind active. Gholdengo SpA-2 from Make It Rain resets on switch-out. Plan: T4 switch Incineroar+TR; T5 under TR attack or pivot Incineroar->Gholdengo at full SpA; T6 TR active+Tailwind expired, Gholdengo+Farigiraf outspeed. Keep Farigiraf alive (Armor Tail blocks Prankster). Archaludon (Stamina) and Stunfisk-G (Mimicry) on bench — Archaludon is special wincon threat with ElectroShot. Incineroar Parting Shot can further lower Quaquaval Atk to -2 if needed.

decisions.rationale: Mega Charizard-Y Heat Wave is super-effective vs Gholdengo (47-141% possible OHKO) and hits Farigiraf neutrally. Quaquaval Ice Spinner pressures Farigiraf (24-58%) to discourage Trick Room. Both move first under Tailwind. Gholdengo at -2 SpA is weakened; removing it eliminates the main threat. Farigiraf Trick Room is the main risk but Ice Spinner damages it.
decisions.notebook: Opponent relies on Pelipper + Swampert rain core. Gholdengo Modest Leftovers Good as Gold, -2 SpA after turn 3. Incineroar Careful Sitrus Berry. Farigiraf Quiet Mental Herb Armor Tail. Klefki Calm Light Clay Prankster. Charizard-Y loses weather war vs Pelipper but pressures Gholdengo/Incineroar. Quaquaval Ice Spinner 2x vs Swampert. Prioritize eliminating Gholdengo. Avoid leading Charizard-Y into rain core. Encore highly effective vs Prankster support. Game 2: Whimsicott/Grimmsnarl fainted turn 3. Charizard/Quaquaval active turn 4. Tailwind 2 turns left. Reflect 6 turns. Light Screen 5 turns foe.

decisions.rationale: Close Combat guaranteed OHKOs Incineroar at -1 Atk. Parting Shot drops Quaquaval to -2 Atk then switches to Gholdengo (Ghost-immune to Fighting). Under TR Incineroar moves before foes. Farigiraf Protects from Charizard's SolarBeam. Gholdengo enters at full SpA (Make It Rain reset). Next turn TR active+Tailwind gone, Gholdengo+Farigiraf outspeed for strong offense.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: CharizarditeY Mega Evolves T4 -> Drought active. Tool does NOT apply sun weather boost nor Weather Ball type/BP change — must manually account for 1.5x Fire boost and Weather Ball becoming Fire/100BP in sun. Light Screen (doubles 2/3 reduction) roughly cancels sun boost on special Fire moves. Quaquaval Close Combat GUARANTEED OHKOs Incineroar even at -1 Atk with Life Orb (232-373%). Gholdengo is Fighting-immune (Steel/Ghost) — best switch-in vs Quaquaval. Gholdengo SpA-2 from Make It Rain resets on switch-out. Plan: T5 Parting Shot pivot to Gholdengo at full SpA; T6+ under TR (3 turns) Gholdengo+Farigiraf outspeed foes (Tailwind expired). Keep Farigiraf alive (Armor Tail blocks Prankster Encore). Archaludon (Stamina) special wincon threat with ElectroShot. Stunfisk-G (Mimicry, speed 37-84) could outspeed my team under TR if switched in — watch for Earthquake SE vs Gholdengo's Steel typing. Klefki (100%, Prankster) available as backup screen setter.

decisions.rationale: Incineroar Fake Out +3 priority flinches Quaquaval before it acts under Trick Room. Protecting Quacquaval dodges the flinch while Heat Wave spreads 27-83% to Farigiraf at 37% for likely KO and 13-37% to Incineroar. Safer than risking Aqua Step flinch with no follow-up.
decisions.notebook: Opponent Pelipper+Swampert rain core unused game 2. Gholdengo -2 SpA benched. Incineroar Careful Sitrus Berry Fake Out priority threat. Farigiraf Quiet Mental Herb Armor Tail Trick Room setter. Klefki Prankster Light Clay screens. Charizard-Y special attacker burn immune to damage drop. Quaquaval Life Orb Moxie physical wincon. Tailwind expires turn 5 end. Trick Room 3 turns remain. Prioritize KOing Farigiraf then pressuring Incineroar. Avoid leading into rain core. Encore effective vs Prankster but both users fainted.

decisions.rationale: Under TR Incineroar (80) outspeeds both foes. Parting Shot hits Quaquaval first, dropping Atk/SpA and pivoting to Gholdengo — immune to Close Combat, resists Aqua Step. Farigiraf Psychic does 56-166% SE to Quaquaval at 90%, chunking or KOing. Even if Farigiraf falls to Heat Wave, Gholdengo is in at full SpA under TR with 2 TR turns remaining for Make It Rain pressure. Quaquaval Protect is ~33%; acceptable risk vs reward.

Klefki (100%, Prankster) available as backup screen setter. Farigiraf Psychic vs Quaquaval: 56-166% with exact SpA 143. Charizard Heat Wave vs Farigiraf: 19-91% (sun+LightScreen cancel, spread 0.75x included).

decisions.rationale: Klefki at 100% HP survives Charizard's debuffed Heat Wave far better than Gholdengo at 69%. Prankster Thunder Wave on Charizard is priority — works regardless of TR — and since Charizard is already slowest under TR, paralysis doesn't worsen TR order but permanently cripples it post-TR. Gholdengo saved for post-TR cleanup where its 104 speed and Thunderbolt SE vs Charizard shine. Klefki can also TWave Archaludon (not Ground).
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Klefki switch-in T7 to replace Incineroar. Plan: Prankster TWave Charizard (priority, Charizard already slowest under TR so no order downside; cripples post-TR). Gholdengo(69%) saved for post-TR cleanup — 104 speed good in normal order, Thunderbolt SE vs Charizard Flying. Stunfisk-G Earthquake SE vs all Steel types on my team (Klefki, Gholdengo); TWave doesn't work on Ground types. Archaludon is TWave-able (Steel/Dragon, not Ground). Charizard atk-2/spa-1; Light Screen(doubles 2/3) + spa-1 roughly cancel sun 1.5x Fire boost. Opponent Reflect(physical 2/3 reduction) up — favor special attackers. Incineroar(62%) on bench for later Intimidate/Parting Shot pivot.

decisions.rationale: Focus fire on Farigiraf (37% HP) with Heat Wave spread + Aqua Step. Combined damage 53.8-159.5% should KO it, removing Trick Room setter. Risk: Farigiraf Psychic may KO Quaquaval first under TR order, but KOing Farigiraf is priority to open field for Charizard-Y. Incineroar Fake Out has no flinch since active multiple turns.
decisions.notebook: Farigiraf Quiet Mental Herb TR setter removed. Incineroar Careful Sitrus Berry Intimidate. Gholdengo -2 SpA benched. Klefki Prankster Light Clay screens. Pelipper Drizzle Damp Rock + Swampert-Mega Swift Swim rain core unused. Charizard-Y special attacker burn immune. Quaquaval Life Orb Moxie physical wincon. Prioritize KOing TR setters. Avoid leading into rain core. Encore effective vs Prankster but both users fainted.

decisions.rationale: Klefki at 46% is in mortal danger from incoming foe (SE Earthquake physical no screen help, or SE Flash Cannon). Switching to Incineroar brings Intimidate to cut physical damage and Fire/Dark resists Flash Cannon and all Charizard moves. Farigiraf at 11% must Protect to survive. Only Incineroar takes the hit, and with Intimidate+resists it survives most scenarios. Klefki preserved for later Prankster TWave on Charizard/Archaludon post-TR.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Gholdengo at -2 SpA from Make It Rain (persisted) — severely limits cleanup potential, Thunderbolt vs Charizard only ~15-25%. Charizard atk-2/spa-1 permanent (Intimidate+Parting Shot), sun+LightScreen expiring T8 — Charizard becomes very weak post-sun. Opponent remaining: Archaludon (Steel/Dragon, Modest, Leftovers, Stamina, TWave-able) and Stunfisk-Galar (Ground/Steel, Adamant, SitrusBerry, Mimicry, immune to TWave). Stunfisk base 81 Atk/32 Spe — slowest under TR, Earthquake is spread SE vs all my Steel types. Plan: survive T7, use TR T8 (last turn) for Farigiraf Helping Hand or pivot, then post-TR use Klefki Prankster TWave on Charizard/Archaludon (priority bypasses speed). Incineroar for Intimidate/Parting Shot pivots. Win condition: attrition — opponent has 2 fainted, I have 0; preserve numbers and clean up weakened Charizard post-sun.

decisions.rationale: No valid decision (empty response); defaulted to the first legal option for each slot.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Incineroar)
decisions.rationale: Farigiraf Trick Room gambles on Archaludon send-in (Farigiraf 72 outspeeds under TR, resets TR for 5 turns). If Stunfisk comes, Farigiraf dies to EQ before acting — same outcome as switching but Gholdengo enters as replacement taking zero damage instead of eating a potentially lethal Heat Wave. Incineroar Protects to avoid all damage. Either way I end with Incineroar 51% + Gholdengo 69% fresh; TR reset is a massive bonus when Archaludon appears.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Gholdengo at -2 SpA from Make It Rain (persisted) — severely limits cleanup potential. Charizard atk-3/spa-1 permanent (Intimidate+Parting Shot). Stunfisk-Galar base 32 Spe — under TR goes first, Earthquake spread SE vs Incineroar2x, immune to TWave (Ground). Archaludon base 85 Spe Modest — TWave-able, Stamina ability. Opponent has 2 fainted (Whimsicott, Grimmsnarl, Quaquaval all dead). Win condition: attrition with numbers advantage; Klefki Prankster TWave on Charizard/Archaludon post-TR for speed control; Incineroar Will-O-Wisp on Stunfisk to halve EQ damage; Gholdengo Shadow Ball as only neutral option vs Stunfisk (TBolt immune, Make It Rain NVE). Sun+LightScreen expiring T8 makes Charizard much weaker post-sun.

decisions.rationale: Gholdengo can Protect to scout Stunfisk-Galar Earthquake (possible OHKO on all my Pokémon). Klefki at 46% with no Protect dies to EQ if Stunfisk comes in. Bring Klefki later via Parting Shot for safe Prankster TWave. Charizard is neutered (-3 Atk/-1 SpA, Heat Wave does 10-37% to Incineroar) so it's not an immediate threat.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Gholdengo -2 SpA persistent; all its attacks NVE/immune vs Stunfisk-Galar (Shadow Ball 0.5x, Make It Rain 0.5x, TBolt 0x). Only neutral vs Archaludon is TBolt. Charizard permanently neutered (-3 Atk/-1 SpA). Stunfisk-Galar EQ spread = biggest threat (SE vs all my team, doesn't hit Charizard Flying). Plan: Gholdengo Protect scouts EQ → Incineroar Will-O-Wisp burns Stunfisk → Parting Shot pivots to Klefki for Prankster TWave on Charizard/Archaludon. Win by attrition: 3v3 with numbers + debuffs. Opponent team = Tailwind-based (Whimsicott), not TR.

decisions.rationale: Heat Wave guarantees KO on Farigiraf at 11% and chips Incineroar. Farigiraf likely Protects but we must pressure. Burn risk acceptable as Charizard special attacker. Quaquaval fainted must pass.
decisions.notebook: Farigiraf Quiet Mental Herb TR setter removed. Incineroar Careful Sitrus Berry Intimidate. Gholdengo -2 SpA benched. Klefki Prankster Light Clay screens. Pelipper Drizzle Damp Rock + Swampert-Mega Swift Swim rain core unused. Charizard-Y special attacker. Quaquaval Life Orb Moxie physical wincon fainted. Prioritize KOing TR setters. Avoid leading into rain core. Encore effective vs Prankster but both users fainted. Game 2: Charizard-Mega-Y solo vs Incineroar Farigiraf. Sun TR both 1 turn left. Farigiraf 11% likely Protect. Incineroar 51% threatens Will-O-Wisp. Need to KO Farigiraf to reduce threats.

decisions.rationale: Gholdengo must Protect: EQ(27-78%)+Heat Wave(55-135%) combined KOs it at 69%. Incineroar Will-O-Wisp burns foe 2 (likely Stunfisk-Galar), permanently halving EQ—the biggest threat to all 3 remaining mons. Incineroar at 51%+Sitrus survives most EQ rolls, and usually outspeeds Stunfisk(37-84 vs 80) so burn lands first. If foe 2 is Archaludon, burn is wasted but Gholdengo is safe and Archaludon can't touch it. Next turn: Parting Shot to Klefki for Prankster TWave.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Gholdengo -2 SpA persistent; all its attacks NVE/immune vs Stunfisk-Galar (Shadow Ball 0.5x, Make It Rain 0.5x, TBolt 0x). Only neutral vs Archaludon is TBolt. Charizard permanently neutered (-3 Atk/-1 SpA). Stunfisk-Galar EQ spread = biggest threat (SE vs all my team, doesn't hit Charizard Flying). Plan: Gholdengo Protect scouts EQ → Incineroar Will-O-Wisp burns Stunfisk → Parting Shot pivots to Klefki for Prankster TWave on Charizard/Archaludon. Win by attrition: 3v3 with numbers + debuffs. Opponent team = Tailwind-based (Whimsicott), not TR. Charizard-Mega-Y Heat Wave spread vs Gholdengo = 55-135% (possible OHKO even at -1 SpA); Gholdengo must Protect when EQ threat is live.

decisions.rationale: Heat Wave spread is the best play to pressure both foes. At -1 SpA, it does ~38-106% to Gholdengo (68% HP), with a real chance to OHKO and remove the Thunderbolt threat. Incineroar takes ~9-25% NVE. Protect wastes a turn and loses Reflect without making progress. Solar Beam is NVE and does only 15-44% to Gholdengo. Even if Gholdengo survives, it's heavily damaged and easier to finish next turn.
decisions.notebook: Charizard-Mega-Y is special attacker with Heat Wave, Solar Beam, Weather Ball, Protect. At -3 Atk, -1 SpA from Intimidate x2 and Parting Shot. Quaquaval fainted as physical wincon. Opponent has Incineroar (Sitrus Berry, Intimidate) and Gholdengo (Leftovers, Good as Gold) active. Klefki (45% HP, Prankster screens) and rain core (Pelipper + Swampert-Mega) still available. Game 2: prioritize KOing Gholdengo to remove Thunderbolt threat. Avoid leading into rain core. Sun ended turn 8, so Weather Ball is unboosted Normal-type. Reflect expires turn 10.

decisions.rationale: Gholdengo is the only Pokémon that can KO Charizard (Thunderbolt SE, 2 hits). If it stays in, Heat Wave+EQ guarantees its death from 75%. Switching to Klefki sacrifices a 46% Pokémon that dies to any SE hit anyway, while preserving Gholdengo for the endgame. Incineroar Protects to stay at 66%. Next turn bring Gholdengo back; Charizard is useless at -3 Atk/-1 SpA, making it effectively 2v2 vs Stunfisk/Archaludon.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Gholdengo -2 SpA persistent; all attacks NVE/immune vs Stunfisk-Galar (Shadow Ball 0.5x, Make It Rain 0.5x, TBolt 0x). Only neutral vs Archaludon is TBolt. Charizard permanently neutered (-3 Atk/-1 SpA). Stunfisk-Galar EQ spread = biggest threat (SE vs all my team, doesn't hit Charizard Flying). Opponent team = Tailwind-based (Whimsicott), not TR. Key damage benchmarks: Thunderbolt vs Charizard 46-99% (cannot OHKO from 100%, needs 2 hits). Heat Wave vs Gholdengo ~41-82% at -1 SpA (possible KO from 75%). EQ vs Gholdengo 33-78% spread. Combined Heat Wave+EQ = guaranteed KO on Gholdengo. Klefki at low HP is sacrificial (dies to any SE hit from 46%). Gholdengo is sole Charizard killer — must preserve. Incineroar cannot damage Charizard (all moves neutral/status, WoW immune vs Fire). If Gholdengo+Farigiraf both dead, Incineroar Parting Shot has no switch target. Plan: sacrifice Klefki to preserve Gholdengo, bring Gholdengo back next turn, 2x Thunderbolt KOs Charizard, win 2v2 by attrition vs Stunfisk/Archaludon.

reflections.summary: Won through attrition: Incineroar's Parting Shot and Will-O-Wisp progressively neutered Mega Charizard-Y's damage, while Gholdengo's Steel/Ghost typing let it tank hits and serve as the primary wincon. Shadow Ball finished Charizard at 23%. The plan worked despite Klefki being sacked on a predictable switch into Heat Wave on turn 10.
reflections.adjustment: Klefki (Steel/Fairy, 4x Fire-weak) was a liability against Mega Charizard-Y's spread Heat Wave and died immediately on entry. Question whether Klefki belongs in this matchup at all—a bulkier screen setter or a different fourth slot would reduce self-inflicted losses. Preserve Gholdengo's HP earlier; it reached 49% and burned on the final turn, which would have mattered in a longer game.
reflections.notebook: Series complete: won 2-0. Opponent Mega Charizard-Y spams Heat Wave as primary spread attack; protects predictably when threatened at low HP. Opponent core: Charizard-Y + Whimsicott (Tailwind/Encore) + Grimmsnarl (screens/Fake Out) + Quaquaval (Moxie sweeper); back row Archaludon (Stamina) and Galarian Stunfisk (Mimicry). Gholdengo is the universal wincon vs this opponent: walls Archaludon (all STAB 0.5x), Shadow Ball is best neutral attack, Thunderbolt hits Charizard super-effectively. Burn risk from Heat Wave on Gholdengo is a real concern—plan healing or faster KO if series continues. Incineroar debuffing chain (Intimidate + Parting Shot + Will-O-Wisp) is the key Charizard-Y answer. Klefki is a poor bring into Fire-heavy teams; consider alternatives for similar archetypes.

reflections.summary: The team preview was fundamentally flawed: leading Charizard-Y sun core against the opponent's Incineroar + Gholdengo backbone provided no reliable offensive pressure. Heat Wave is resisted by both, Gholdengo is immune to status via Good as Gold, and after Whimsicott and Grimmsnarl fell early, Charizard-Y was picked off by Gholdengo's Thunderbolt and Incineroar's Parting Shot chip. Quaquaval—the only mon that could threaten Gholdengo with Aqua Step—fainted before making meaningful impact.
reflections.adjustment: Lead with Quaquaval as the primary win condition against Gholdengo rather than a sacrificial support piece. Preserve it behind dual Prankster screens long enough to land Aqua Step or Close Combat, and reconsider Charizard-Y as the Mega against this specific matchup since its Fire-type coverage is dead weight against this core.
reflections.notebook: Opponent's core: Incineroar (Sitrus Berry, Will-O-Wisp, Parting Shot, Intimidate) + Gholdengo (Leftovers, Thunderbolt, Shadow Ball, Good as Gold) — both resist Fire, Gholdengo immune to status. Gholdengo Protects when pressured, goes for Shadow Ball KO when opponent is vulnerable. Alternate leads: Trick Room Farigiraf (Mental Herb, Armor Tail) and Klefki (Light Clay, screens). Charizard-Y + Prankster support cannot break this core; Quaquaval (Life Orb, Moxie, Aqua Step/Close Combat) is the necessary offensive answer but must be preserved as primary attacker.
